reasons.plausibility: The formation of a protective chromium oxide layer on steels is a well-known and sound mechanism for corrosion resistance in such applications.
reasons.testability: The proposed controlled exposures and measurements (oxide film characterization, corrosion rate tests) offer a clear and decisive methodology to confirm or refute the role of the Cr2O3 film.
reasons.usefulness: Although this strategy aligns with established principles for stainless steels, verifying exact composition thresholds under specific service extremes is valuable for refining alloy design.
